hero.positioningLine: For learner and future learner driver preparation.
hero.headline: Build theory, lesson, and route confidence before, during, and after learning to drive.
hero.subhead: Start theory, Highway Code, traffic signs, and fines preparation early, then move into structured local practice routes, instructor discovery, bookings, parking support, and calmer learner-first navigation when your stage allows.

startPaths.title: How Drivest works
startPaths.intro: Future learners and learners use the same preparation path, while instructors follow a separate operating flow. Drivest uses role-based onboarding so the right legal prompts, permissions, modules, and progress tools appear in the right order.

summary.title: Role-based onboarding
summary.text: The first choice decides what the person sees next. Future learners and learners move into theory and practice support, while instructors move into profile setup, marketplace readiness, and Instructor Hub operations.

paths.title: Start learner preparation
paths.text: Use the learner preparation flow whether you are starting theory early or already moving into practical preparation, instructor booking, and calmer navigation.
bullets: Future learner drivers can begin theory, signs, Highway Code, and fines preparation early before practical lessons start.
When ready, create or continue a learner profile, choose your current stage, and confirm the safety and legal acknowledgements used before data collection starts.
Pick one of 32 supported languages, then peek into English whenever you want to cross-check the same theory question.
Set your analytics, notification, and location preferences before opening Theory, Traffic Signs, Highway Code, or Fines and Penalties.
Move into Practice, Find Instructor, and Navigation as your confidence score, booking history, and progress tracking build up.

paths.title: Join as instructor
paths.text: Use the instructor flow when you need profile approval, marketplace visibility, linked learners, bookings, and operating records from the start.
bullets: Create your instructor account and complete the professional legal flow and instructor agreement required before listing.
Set up your public profile, coverage area, availability, and lesson preferences so learners can discover and request slots.
Open Instructor Hub to link learners, track bookings and payment status, and keep coaching context together in one place.
Use reviews, dispute records, notifications, and learner insights to manage your independent instructor business through Drivest.

why.title: Driving support changes by stage.
bullets: Before lessons: future learner drivers can start theory, signs, Highway Code, and fines revision early in a format they can actually understand.
Before test day: practical learners need repetition around a selected centre, clearer coaching context, and instructor access.
After passing: new drivers need calmer route choice, parking support, and confidence-building guidance.

infoSections.title: Marketplace terms and cancellations
infoSections.text: Drivest marketplace lessons are delivered by independent instructors. The platform records an 8% fee on completed lessons and no commission on cancelled lessons.
bullets: 48 hours or more before a lesson: full refund
24 to 48 hours before a lesson: up to 25% may be retained by the instructor
12 to 24 hours before a lesson: up to 50% may be retained by the instructor
Less than 12 hours before a lesson or no-show: no refund
If the instructor cancels, the learner receives a full refund

safety.title: Safety and trust
bullets: Real-world driving, lessons, bookings, and navigation must follow UK legal requirements.
Drivest guidance is advisory only and may be incomplete or delayed.

Keep full control of the vehicle and always follow live road signs, road markings, and traffic laws.

faq.a: Drivest provides future learner and learner preparation tools, reconstructed practice routes, advisory navigation support, parking guidance, progress tracking, subscriptions, and, where enabled, instructor marketplace and booking features.

faq.q: Is Drivest only for people already taking lessons?
faq.a: No. Drivest is also positioned for future learner driver preparation. Users can begin theory, Highway Code, traffic signs, and fines preparation early before practical lessons begin.
No. Drivest is an independent product and has no affiliation with the Driver and Vehicle Standards Agency or any government authority.

faq.q: Are Drivest routes official driving test routes?
faq.a: No. Routes are reconstructed or generated for learning and practice only and must never be described as official test routes.

faq.q: Can I study in another language and still check the English question?
faq.a: Yes. Drivest supports theory learning across 32 languages. Learners can study in a preferred language and peek into English to cross-check the same question when they want to compare wording.

faq.q: Can I rely on Drivest as the final authority while driving?
faq.a: No. Users must always follow live road signs, real-world conditions, traffic laws, and any instruction from an instructor, examiner, police officer, or other authority.

faq.q: Does Drivest guarantee parking legality or availability?
faq.a: No. Parking outputs are advisory only. Users must check local signage and local restrictions before leaving a vehicle.

faq.q: What subscription plans does Drivest offer?
faq.a: Drivest offers an annual navigation plan, an annual navigation plan bundled with one month of practice route access for one selected test centre, and a monthly practice routes plan. Free learning and onboarding access remain available before upgrading.

faq.q: Do practice routes last for the full bundled annual subscription period?
faq.a: Not always. Under the bundled annual navigation and limited practice route plan, navigation continues for the annual period but route access for the chosen centre expires after one month unless extended through a separate purchase.

Where marketplace features are live, Drivest allows learners to discover instructors, select availability, book a lesson, and complete payment through the platform. The lesson itself remains a contract between the learner and the instructor.

faq.q: What is the lesson cancellation policy?
faq.a: If a learner cancels 48 hours or more before the lesson, a full refund applies. Between 24 and 48 hours, up to 25% may be retained by the instructor. Between 12 and 24 hours, up to 50% may be retained. Less than 12 hours before the lesson, no refund applies. If the instructor cancels, the learner receives a full refund.
Drivest may carry out limited checks for platform integrity, but it does not certify or guarantee instructor qualifications or status unless this is expressly stated.

Depending on the features used, Drivest may process account details, device and technical data, learning progress, route activity, booking records, payment metadata, consent records, review content, dispute evidence, and audit logs.

faq.q: Does Drivest track my location all the time?
faq.a: No. Location is used where route, hazard, or parking features require it and where device permission is granted. Drivest does not store continuous background location history on its servers unless that is clearly disclosed in a future version.
No. Drivest does not sell personal data for advertising or marketing purposes.

A learner or instructor may submit a dispute through the platform where available. Drivest may review the available record, including logs, timestamps, payment data, and evidence, and may make a platform decision such as no action, refund, restriction, or suspension.

faq.q: How do I request access to or deletion of my data?
faq.a: Email admin@drivest.uk with the request details. Identity verification may be required before action is taken.
